what: Inside the panel, a photo is spawned one at a time at .3~.7s intervals (.45~1.05s when panel width is under 768). It starts from the left edge (two of three, height −10~110%) or the bottom edge (one of three, width −10~110%) and drifts straight (linear) toward the upper right by the panel’s width and height over 15~50s. Photos are clipped to an ellipse (1 in 51 is a star) and tumble around rotate3d(1,1,1) once every 10~50s in either a forward or backward direction. With no perspective, a tilted photo flattens like a blade and then opens back to a circle. Each appears with a 2s ease on spawn and is removed once it has passed. The cover and icon (solo) each have just one photo flowing along the same path in 10~20s (at 20~80% position), and a new one appears right after it passes.

options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Source photos to stream out (children, several) — hidden and copied out in shuffled order. data-ratio holds height÷width (default .6667), data-shape holds round (default)·square
options.[data-fx-part=solo]: Cover or icon that spins individually, one by one (child, can be a link — only this is clickable). Default shape square, data-size="1.2 12.5" as the width range (%), and to set it separately on narrow layouts use data-size-narrow="1.5 25"
options.size-min · size-max: Photo width (% of panel width), default 3 · 25 — below panel width 768 it is 3x · 2.5x
options.solo-min · solo-max: Time for cover and icons to drift (ms), default 10000 · 20000
options.every-min · every-max: Spawn interval (ms) — drawn once at first and kept as the tempo to the end, default 300 · 700 (1.5x on narrow layouts)
options.star: Probability that a star shape appears 1/(star+1), default 50 — 0 means no stars
options.narrow: Width (px) treated as the narrow layout, default 768

use: …
note: The panel is pointer-events: none so it does not block the text or links below, and only solo can be pressed. If the panel is off screen or the tab is hidden, no new ones are spawned. Stacking two panels lets you split them as in the original: the photo stream under the logo, the cover and icon stream over the logo. With reduced motion, only the first six sheets stay in place, tilted. Inside the photo If present, spawns after everything is fully received (decode) like the original — placeholder boxes have no file to receive so they appear right away

from.where: index.html .ur-stream and .ur-stream--over. Original .js-home-gallery (349 photos, minSize 3, maxSize 25, minTiming 300, maxTiming 700, gallery-h/v 15~50s, rotating and rotating2 10~50s) and .js-home-gallery-2 (cover 10~20s, icon width .4×3~.5×25%)
